name: Finances
description: Your debts and what you are owed: the Kennzahlen of the debts database — what you owe, what you are owed, the instalments a month, months until debt-free. Slice 1 of the port: the rest of Finances (income, spending, formulas, widgets, the overviews) is still the built-in's.
author: Zeff

sources.label: Recurring payments
sources.hint: What goes out regularly to the same recipient — contracts and subscriptions read off your bank statements.

widgets.label: Payments coming up
widgets.description: The instalments and payments of your debts (or what comes back to you) in the next weeks — the overdue first, each leading to its debt.

widgets.label: Cashflow ahead
widgets.description: Your account in the next weeks: income, fixed costs, subscriptions, instalments and payments ahead — the balance week by week and the first day it drops below zero (or your buffer).

settings.label: Balance today (empty: only the net a month)

metrics.label: Schuldenstand (Plugin)
metrics.what: What you owe in all, still open

metrics.label: Offene Schulden (Plugin)
metrics.what: How many debts are still open

metrics.label: Tilgungsrate (Plugin)
metrics.what: The instalments you pay a month (the plans running now)

metrics.label: Schuldenfrei in (Plugin)
metrics.what: Months until the last debt with a plan is paid off

metrics.label: Schulden ohne Plan (Plugin)
metrics.what: What you owe without a payment plan

metrics.label: Forderungen (Plugin)
metrics.what: What others owe you, still open

metrics.label: Offene Forderungen (Plugin)
metrics.what: How many debts others have with you, still open

metrics.label: Rückzahlungen (Plugin)
metrics.what: What comes back to you a month

metrics.label: Alles zurück in (Plugin)
metrics.what: Months until the last debt to you with a plan is paid back

metrics.label: Forderungen ohne Plan (Plugin)
metrics.what: What you are owed without a payment plan

metrics.label: Nettoeinkommen (Plugin)
metrics.what: Your net income a month (set by hand, or read off your statements)

metrics.label: Ausgaben (Plugin)
metrics.what: What was spent a month — the last three whole months of your bank statements, on average

metrics.label: Auf Kreditkonten (Plugin)
metrics.what: What went to the accounts you marked as credit accounts a month

metrics.label: Frei im Monat (Plugin)
metrics.what: What is left of your income after the instalments and the fixed costs

metrics.label: Sparquote (Plugin)
metrics.what: Of your income, the part that didn't go out

metrics.label: Schuldendienstquote (Plugin)
metrics.what: Of your income, the part the instalments take
